android.desc:
***** NOW WITH MULTIPLAYER MODE AND ACHIEVEMENTS! *****

Mega Memory for Kids is a memory game for kids and adults with quality pictures and sound effects.
Train you memory with this easy to understand game. Improve your memory skills and have fun while doing it, with lots of different themes, like animals, fruits, vehicles and shapes.

Play against your friends or let the game randomly select your opponent to see who's got the best memory!

You will need a Google+ account to be able to utilize Multiplayer, Leaderboards and Achievements.

To be able to receive invites from other players while not in-game it is recommended to install the Google Play Games app: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.google.android.play.games

Twitter: https://twitter.com/MegaMemoryKids
Google+: https://plus.google.com/u/0/b/118404901227343022913/118404901227343022913
